import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
c=bpy.data.collections['Terminal_Craft']
for o in c.objects:
 if any(s in o.name for s in ['Gallery substrate','Gallery slate','Pennant bearer','suspension tab']):
  if 'Gallery slate' in o.name and not o.name.endswith(('001','008','036','044')):continue
  pts=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box]
  print(o.name,tuple(round(min(v[k] for v in pts),3) for k in range(3)),tuple(round(max(v[k] for v in pts),3) for k in range(3)))
